metadata.title: DiaryLoop: a little English diary, every day
metadata.description: An English diary in 5 to 30 minutes a day. An AI pen pal answers your day first, then gently helps your English sound more natural.

home.title: How was your day?
home.lead: Write it down in English. Three sentences is enough.

styleguide.title: Design system
styleguide.intro: Every color, typeface, and component, light and dark side by side.
styleguide.sampleDiary: Today I finally finished my report, and I treated myself to a warm bowl of noodles.
styleguide.sampleBody: Interface text: gentle, simple, with room to breathe.
styleguide.sampleSupporting: Supporting text: dates, word counts, hints.
styleguide.fieldHint: Separate with commas, e.g. school, friends
styleguide.penPal: How the pen pal's letter looks: a soft green.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.lead: Deleting removes every diary entry, photo, chat, letter to your future self, and notebook item, permanently and at once.
delete.warning: This can't be undone. We won't be able to recover anything for you.
delete.confirm: I understand all my entries and photos will be deleted forever

error.failed: Couldn't delete. Please try again later; your data is still here.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Sign in with Google to keep your diary in the cloud, on any device.

promise.private: Only you can read your diary; not even admins can see it.
promise.training: Your diary is never used to train AI models.
promise.delete: Export or permanently delete everything, any time.

result.failed: Sign-in didn't work. Please try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to DiaryLoop
welcome.lead: One quick thing before you start.
welcome.birthMonthHint: Only used to check your age; never shown to anyone.
welcome.guardian: If you are under 18: my parent or guardian has read the Privacy Policy and Terms and agrees that I use DiaryLoop.

error.birthMonth: Please choose a valid birth month.
error.consent: Under 18, a parent or guardian needs to agree. Please tick the box above.
error.failed: Couldn't save. Please try again later.

tooYoung.title: Thanks for your interest
tooYoung.body: DiaryLoop is for people 13 and older. To protect your privacy, the account you just created has been deleted and nothing was kept. You're welcome back once you're 13!
